## 2b. Agents (from `npm run metrics -- --md`, "Agents" table)

Read these before the anomalies. Each one is a question to answer, not just a number to report:
- **Roles never dispatched:** is the role unneeded (retire it, write an offboarding record), or is the chief of staff doing its work alone and skipping its check (for example QA, release, design)?
- **Stop rate:** usage limits, crashes, restarts. Above 10% means re-plan the concurrency.
- **Tokens per run by role,** against last week: did a brief get bloated?
- **Rework:** lessons revised ÷ lessons built. Rising rework means fix the upstream role (briefs, design), not the builders.
- **First-review launch rate by builder model** (EXP-003).
- **Brief errors found by builders:** count them from build notes and board items. They are a measure of category-manager quality.

Readings (analytics steward, 2026-10-17; source `npm run metrics -- --md` and `node tools/ops-health.mjs` at ~17:20Z):

| Metric | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Agent runs (all time) | 997 dispatched, 986 reported, 35 stopped at least once (4%) | Under the 10% re-plan line. ops-health counts 1120 dispatched / 902 finished / 5% stopped: the two tools count differently; do not compare them across tools. |
| Tokens (recorded runs) | 107.2M | The usage records end 2026-10-16T15:27Z, so tokens per run cover no work after then. |
| Last 24 h | 0 runs, 0 tokens (ops-health burn rate) | **Anomaly, see below.** |
| Roles never dispatched | 32 of 103 | These include personalization-engineer, learner-data-engineer, researcher, courses-lead and most sub-category managers. Head of product or the chief of staff should decide whether each role is unneeded or its check is being skipped. |
| Rework | 542 of 974 lessons revised at least once (56%) | No prior week figure has been recorded to compare against. |
| First-review launch rate (EXP-003) | opus 379/844 (45%), sonnet 55/82 (67%) | The samples are unequal and lessons were not randomly assigned to models. Treat it as descriptive, not an EXP-003 result. |

**Anomaly: 0 runs / 0 tokens in the last 24 h, although this session dispatched about 40 agents.** `company/ops/events.jsonl` holds 11 `dispatch` and 9 `report` events in the last 24 h, the latest at 17:17Z. The rest went through the mailbox. None of these events has a token field: they are hand-written and carry no usage. Each hypothesis below predicts something different:
- H1, the agent-events hook is not loaded (W-1280; this session's project dir is /home/user, not the repo). This predicts no `hk-` events and no `company/ops/events-spool/` directory (it does not exist today), and usage records that stop when hook-loaded sessions stopped. A session opened in /home/user/system-3-company should then produce `hk-` dispatch/report events with tokens.
- H2, burn rate counts only token-bearing run records, so hand-written events never count. This predicts 0 even with H1 fixed, unless reports carry usage. Probe: confirm against tools/ops-health.mjs.
- H3, work really stopped. This is already contradicted by the 17:17Z dispatch event.
- Owner: chief-of-staff (W-1280, already on the board) to run the H1 probe, with principal-engineer-ops for the ops-health counting (H2). Until this is fixed, tokens per role and burn rate this week understate spend and must not be compared to last week.
